'''Rousaul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] residing on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] around [[3643 BBY]], when she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]-affiliated individual. She was part of a secret [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] mission to spy on [[Kaas City]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rousaul appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Dromund Kaas. She is not directly involved in any quests, however she appears in the area for the mission "Into the Maw" and can be killed by any Imperial character for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
